subject.title: feat: play ordered track URI lists

question: Should `spogo play` officially accept multiple track arguments and transparently use Web API playback when the selected Connect engine cannot represent the ordered list?
rationale: The patch is technically bounded, but it establishes a new CLI contract and changes the backend used for one class of explicit playback commands; code inspection cannot determine the intended permanent product semantics.

options.title: Sponsor variadic play
options.body: Accept the tracks-only CLI contract and Web API delegation after the contributor supplies convincing live playback proof.

options.title: Keep play singular
options.body: Retain the existing single-resource contract and decline this feature, leaving ordered collections to playlists or repeated queue operations.

options.title: Narrow backend behavior
options.body: Accept multiple tracks only where the chosen engine can support them without transparent cross-engine delegation.

recommendation.title: Sponsor variadic play
recommendation.body: Accept the tracks-only CLI contract and Web API delegation after the contributor supplies convincing live playback proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available repository and release history makes steipete the best-supported owner for the CLI and playback-engine product decision.
